title: Shinonome Akito — A Winter Evening Chat〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Having time to relax is great and all, but I think I'm starting to get bored...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, in that case, there's something I'd like to ask you... That is, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ask me what?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You mentioned how you and your family have been to this campground before, yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more about what you did that time? I'd like to get a preview of where we're going if possible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A preview...? Yeah, that makes sense knowing you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna hear too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, settle down.
I will since we have time to kill.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember the time we went camping when I was in sixth grade the best. We went during spring break after my dad suddenly decided to take us on a trip...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Not during summer?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, according to him, it gets too crowded because of all the tourists.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We went for three days and two nights that time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We started by pitching a tent together... After that, we played around until it was time to eat.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, by we I mean, Ena, my mom and myself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, what about your dad?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, he was there to paint the mountains, the scenery and us running around...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He even drew pictures of us while we went fishing down by this river that was nearby.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
To be fair, he's a professional artist.
I'm guessing that he was looking for some sort of inspiration for his work.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who knows? Oh, but Ena did throw him into the river for not giving her enough attention.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can sympathize with her there. You were there as a family, so it's normal to want to spend time together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. By the way, did you manage to catch any fish?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not even a nibble.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The worst part was how I could see them in the water. After a while, I thought that it'd be faster to just use my hands to catch them, but that didn't work either...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can see that look of frustration on you now. Do you remember doing anything else?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We smashed watermelons...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You did? By a river?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, there's no rule saying that you have to smash them at the beach.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! You can dunk them in the river to get them all nice and cold!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... So it's a different way of enjoying the same activity.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Also, I guess that was the last time we went camping as a family...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I was just trying to remember what else we did that time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, that was probably the most fun I had while camping.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did it help?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it did.
The part about smashing watermelons by a river was very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's what drew your attention?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You used to go camping a lot too, right, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not as much as you think since we had to keep the cafe going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I do remember going fishing and stuff whenever we did go. My dad actually likes to fish as a hobby.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken fishes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! You won't see it on our menu or anything, but he'll prep and cook the fish he catches for us from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: From scratch? Seriously?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? I can remove the innards and stuff, but don't really know how to cook a fish besides grilling it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, that can wait until next time! Our main goal right now is to go check out a forest!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Next time? Our current trip's hardly started yet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. But it might be fun to go fishing with you guys. Who do you think would get the first catch?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, it's a sport that rewards patience, so my bet's on Toya or Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I get that you wouldn't have any luck, but what are you throwing me under the bus for?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because you're the kind of person who thinks about jumping into a river to catch fish instead of using a rod.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's ancient history!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to this trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, so am I...
